per_section.heading: 1. Problem
per_section.diagnosis: The problem statement fixed mass limit and stowed box and simulant and blind operation, which the council met with auditable sums and simulations. It asked for what to satisfy, not how to draw leaders, and it did not invite the bracket simplification, so it let the fault through only in the sense that depiction lives downstream of requirements.
per_section.direction: No change. Keep the limit and envelope wording as the design ground truth and judge depiction separately from requirement closure.
per_section.explains: Mass closure against the limit (E62) and stowed fit against the box (E51) show the problem constraints were already satisfied, so the arm and label errors say nothing about requirement meaning.

per_section.heading: 2. Roles
per_section.diagnosis: Role blocks correctly assigned digging and chassis and blind operation and power integration with cross-domain checks, and the transcript shows each owner supplied the deciding calc or simulation and answered objections. They asked for domain reasoning and interface confirmation, which was delivered, but they do not control leader placement in the image model, so they could not prevent callout duplication.
per_section.direction: No change. Keep complementary ownership and plain-words with numbers and reuse-by-id discipline, and do not add depiction duties to domain roles.
per_section.explains: Kerf force work (E64) with traction (E23) and ladder power (E59) with heating (E44) and clearance with tip factor (E51) show role reasoning was complete, so the render mismatch is not a role gap.

per_section.heading: 3. Tools
per_section.diagnosis: Tools direction to use calc for estimates and simulate for behaviour over time and sketch for layout was followed, with sums naming every term and stop and drift and filling shown over time. It asked for the right analysis, but no calculator controls line-anchoring in a generated image, so faithful analysis could still receive an unfaithful overlay.
per_section.direction: No change. Keep calc versus simulate versus sketch discipline and do not add a drawing-correction calculator, which would not address leader anchoring.
per_section.explains: Stop with link loss (E32) versus brake-only stop (E23) and drift with reset (E33) show behaviour was simulated rather than asserted, so the tool chain did its job before rendering.

per_section.heading: 4. Meeting protocol
per_section.diagnosis: Meeting protocol required plain words first with decisive numbers, reuse of evidence, sketches for flow path, objections with answers, and ready votes only on surviving versions. The meeting followed it through three cycles to unanimous ready with only after-build bench tests open. It asked for convergence on mechanism and limits, not for pixel verification, so it let depiction errors through by design separation.
per_section.direction: No change. Keep manager-decides with member votes and bench-test naming, and do not gate design readiness on leader placement.
per_section.explains: Cycle 3 record shows agreed soil path from kerf to ladder to hopper to screw with cameras guiding, with all votes ready, so protocol closure was achieved before the image step.

per_section.heading: 5. Criteria
per_section.diagnosis: Criteria require physical workability and buildability with ordinary shop methods, which the closed traction margin and power margin and millimetre stiffness and level-only tip rule support. They ask about load path and signal path, not about label count, and the chassis to arm to wheel and kerf to ladder to hopper to auger paths plus battery to ladder and cameras paths remain continuous in the solution despite label errors.
per_section.direction: No change. Keep physical and buildable criteria and judge connectivity from the connection list and sketches rather than from render leaders.
per_section.explains: Connections for side-spoil feed and gravity chute and screw metering with fused power buses show end-to-end continuity, so criteria are met even where leaders are misplaced.

root_cause: Image-model fidelity limit after three rounds, not council under-specification. All contested parts and mechanical and electrical connections and stowed to deployed and clearance geometry were already specified and the chassis to ladder to hopper mounts already matched the sketch, so redraw of arms and leaders and pack labels belongs to depiction, not to design soundness.
agenda: Targeted depiction failure with no design gap. The six feedback items all describe render leaders and bracket drawing that contradict parts and connections already fixed on the board, so no broad prompt rewrite is warranted.
repeat_explanation: No prior distinct failure mode was supplied in this review packet to compare against, so this is treated as a first isolated render-fidelity finding rather than a repeat requiring reverts.
